title: C2r: CORUNDUM keeps IPNS; IPNS key is the content key (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-18, in CORUNDUM): reverses C2, C2a, C2b and the posting-key part of C4. Chain handle -> DID -> IPNS -> RootManifest. DID doc CorundumIdentity service {ipnsName, operatorEndpoint (origin), listKey (X25519), additionalKeys?}. IPNS name = Ed25519 content-signing key (signs activities and RootManifests) + pointer; served via GET /routing/v1/ipns/{name} at operatorEndpoint, DHT fallback. Operator holds content key by default; self-custody optional; update/recovery keys user-only. Content keys in no verification relationship (Agora rejects them unchanged). did:key users: IPNS name derived from the DID; no Pkarr _corundum._agora record. JWS kid = IPNS name (not DID URL); alg Ed25519 (RFC 9864). Source: CORUNDUM c014c29 docs/spec/03-identity.md, 10-crypto.md.
